biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA pathway enrichment shows a coherent upregulation of immune/interferon-related pathways (allograft rejection, IFN-alpha, IFN-gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3) with moderate-to-large SMDs and FDR q<0.01, alongside downregulation of pancreas beta cells. WXS shows a strong, FDR-significant enrichment of BAP1 mutations (OR~20) and a suggestive depletion of PBRM1 mutations that does not survive FDR. CNV shows no FDR-significant differences; the largest effects (chr14q loss, VHL/PBRM1/SETD2 locus gains) have wide CIs and q>0.8, indicating weak and non-estimable precision. Overall, molecular support is driven by RNA and mutation data, with CNV providing no coherent signal.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by an immune-active transcriptomic phenotype and a high frequency of BAP1 mutations, which are recurrent in ccRCC. The PBRM1 depletion trend is consistent with known mutual exclusivity patterns but is not statistically robust. CNV findings are exploratory and do not add clear biological identity.
limitations: RNA and WXS data were available for all 30 set members and 73 rest members; CNV comparisons had similar availability.

reports.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows extensive pathway dysregulation with many FDR-significant pathways, including downregulation of immune pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and upregulation of metabolism/TGF-beta pathways. CNV shows a strong, coherent pattern of reduced copy-number alterations (lower fga, fewer losses of CDKN2A, chr9, chr14q) with moderate-to-large effect sizes and FDR q<0.05. The molecular support is strongest from RNA and CNV, with WXS providing only a trend.
reports.medical_interpretation: The set appears to have a distinct transcriptomic profile with suppressed immune signaling and enhanced metabolic/TGF-beta activity, and a relatively quiet CNV profile with fewer common ccRCC deletions. PBRM1 mutation enrichment is not statistically robust. These features suggest a non-canonical molecular subtype.
limitations: RNA and WXS data were available for all 22 set members and 81 rest members.
